hook: SCP-765 is one of the shortest, gentlest files you are likely to find: a duck pond that makes people feel at peace. Read it as a small mood piece rather than a horror story, and notice how the staffing rules hint that the calm has a limit.
whyItMatters: It shows how little an SCP needs to work: one place, one emotional effect, and a short addendum that shifts the tone. The Foundation even sends stressed researchers there as a kind of break, which gives the file a rare, almost cozy angle on daily life at a site.
thingsToNotice: The serenity sours after seven to twelve days into lethargy, apathy, boredom and depression, which is why staff rotate every three to six days and must stay away a month before returning. The heavily redacted line about three D-class subjects kept in the effect far longer hints at a darker experiment running in the background. Then the addendum undercuts it all with a joke: ducks turn up, apparently unaffected, their presence makes people jollier and slows the downturn, and the doctor recommends trying other waterfowl.
